integrity: The proof differentiates the published support-function equation at the round stationary solution, uses the published derivative formula for the curvature quotient, and diagonalizes the resulting operator with the standard spherical-harmonic Laplacian spectrum. The bundled checker verifies algebraic consistency only; it is not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: This is an exact Fréchet-linearization result at the constant-data stationary sphere. It does not establish a nonlinear faster-rate theorem after scale modulation. An equivalent calculation in unindexed curvature-flow literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Complete spherical-harmonic linearization of the supercritical dual \(k\)-Minkowski sphere
